scope: One original Ad Astra flagship film aligned with documentary-scale astronomy and DJI-style product storytelling

referenceEvidence.uploadedReference: 59.70 second 910x512 30 fps H.264 phone recording of a television displaying third-party documentary material

creative.artDirection: photoreal astronomy to tactile product demonstrations; no generic glowing-head loop
creative.camera: one choreographed visual grammar across all chapters

shots.visual: A nearly black frame reveals a newly simulated corona from a distant star; no inherited title or footage
shots.camera: Slow macro pullback with slight roll and physically consistent highlights
shots.audioDirection: Low evolving subharmonic; restrained; no licensed documentary score

shots.visual: One continuous camera passage from stellar light across the atmosphere of a photoreal original Earth asset
shots.camera: Long focal-length orbital arc and atmospheric transition; keep horizon curvature physically plausible
shots.voiceDirection: We make the complex world easier to see.
shots.audioDirection: First harmonic rise and cinematic air movement

shots.visual: Orbital trajectories become evidence marks and a human-directed interface, never a random light tunnel
shots.camera: Single directed push-in that resolves celestial scale into a readable product plane
shots.voiceDirection: Discovery matters when it becomes understanding.
shots.audioDirection: Rhythmic motive enters beneath original narration

shots.visual: Original scientific workbench showing one bounded inquiry, competing hypotheses and their evidentiary limitations
shots.camera: Macro glide across a high-fidelity spatial dataset; one focal point and deliberate eye-line
shots.voiceDirection: Compare what we know with what remains uncertain.
shots.audioDirection: Precise sonic accents synchronized to evidence changes

shots.visual: An actual learning interaction in a tactile, believable environment; staged demo clearly marked illustrative
shots.camera: Human-scale dolly through layers of a concept into a guided learning outcome
shots.voiceDirection: Knowledge gains power when it becomes accessible.
shots.audioDirection: Warm melodic lift, no narration masking

shots.visual: An accurately labeled synthetic 3D model changes with direct time/rotation controls; physical surface and UI have matched state
shots.camera: Full orbit of a real 3D mesh, then align to corresponding web camera keyframe
shots.voiceDirection: Explore relationships, and control the perspective.
shots.audioDirection: Clear interaction tones and controlled texture

shots.visual: One realistic permission decision flows through a human approval, tenant boundary and receipt; synthetic demo, no false production claim
shots.camera: Lateral single-take tracing one authorized action rather than generic neural-avatar imagery
shots.voiceDirection: Intelligence must remain accountable to people.
shots.audioDirection: Minimal confident rhythm; no artificial success signal

shots.visual: The four differentiated product worlds resolve into one restrained Ad Astra mark and a single intentional explore CTA
shots.camera: Measured pullback into original Earth horizon visual with 2-second legible title hold
shots.voiceDirection: Ad Astra. Beyond the expected. Human-directed.
shots.audioDirection: Resolved orchestral swell and quiet 2-second tail

production.authoring: Unreal Engine Sequencer offline cinematic shots, Houdini procedural plasma where needed, original modeled/rigged assets, color-managed finishing
production.render: 4K 3840x2160 24 fps 10-bit or EXR production master; ACES/linear scene work with SDR Rec.709 delivery grade
production.audio: Original voice and commissioned score only; target web mix approx -16 LUFS integrated and <= -1 dBTP (targets not source measurements)
production.web: Opt-in film modal and poster first, responsive media selection, caption accessibility, pause on close/tab hidden, bounded GPU scenes, fallback stills
production.sceneHandoff: Offline cinematic camera pose and semantic scene IDs feed web ExperienceDirector; WebGL2 mesh handoff at selected shot boundaries, not a claim that film frames are interactive
production.separation: Do not ship production-source assets, raw footage, unreleased movie, private content or rights evidence in public repo

release.existingApprovalAuthority: CRC Supabase independent exact-build release case
